answer: Optimistic payouts with a fraud-proof window: like green timber left to season, each agent's epoch reward sits in a 14-day exit queue. Anyone may post a 50 POA challenge proving two queued identities share a key, funding inlet or answer drafts. A proven link forfeits both queues to the challenger; a false claim burns the 50. An honest agent only waits, but a farm of N fakes exposes N(N-1)/2 linkable pairs, so its risk climbs a steep ridge and every clone is a pearl for bounty hunters.
